name: settings popover OPEN (the language row and the hover-help row — three labels that are invisible at rest)
hover help switched OFF (ui.off — the toggle's other face, which no resting state shows)
a lesson preset picked (label.captionEpiano — the tour caption is chosen by a click and is never the resting string; E-Piano's is the longest of the five in French)

carrier-null badge LIT (label.carrierNull — display:none at rest). This adds the exact class updateRouting() adds, and nothing else: the badge lights when the effective modulation index reaches the first Bessel J0 zero, and the generic stub gives modIndex a neutral 0..1 range whose scaled value can never reach it, so the parameter path cannot be driven to this state from a stub. Driving the class directly is the state the plugin does produce, on the one line that produces it.
